'''Tau Sakar''' was an unremarkable red-orange [[Star/Legends|star]]<ref name="GG" /> around which seven [[Planet/Legends|planets]] orbited, forming the [[Tau Sakar system]].<ref name="GG" /><ref name="GGE" /> The evolution on [[Garban]], the fourth planet from Tau Sakar, followed conventional galactic patterns, according to which organic molecules formed as a result of ultraviolet light reacting with chemical-rich seas.<ref name="GG" /> Eventually, a [[Sentience/Legends|sentient]] [[Species/Legends|species]], the [[Jenet/Legends|Jenet]], arose on Garban.<ref name="GG" /><ref name="GGE" />
